name: Ne dyshi
source:
The cockroaches have taken control of the world.
Roma Sonnov is one of the few brave souls still putting up a fight.
Help him wipe out those nasty critters!
It’s easy — after all, what else do you need but a slipper?

[Translated from [url=https://studio-chutzpah.itch.io/dontdeservetobreath]itch.io[/url]]
